make.description: Optional substring match on exif.make. Used when listing models/lenses for a chosen make.

models.description: Optional comma-separated list of exact exif.model values to restrict lens/aperture/focal facets. Takes precedence over make.

main.description: Aggregate distinct EXIF facet values (makes, models, lenses, apertures, focal lengths, camera/lens gear with counts) across all app.zeens.postMeta records. Powers the search UI's cascading filters and popular-gear chips without needing any client-side aggregation.
